QuestInfo.name: Vague Aran Memories
QuestInfo.0: If you're curious about the Arans, talk to #bCassandra#k.
QuestInfo.1: She says you must collect Vague Aran Memories in order to obtain an Aran Memory Fragment.
QuestInfo.2: You have collected an Aran Memory Fragment. Cassandra told you a story about a girl who's waiting for the heroes in Rien. What was her name...? Li...Lilin?

0.0: The Arans? You must be really curious about them. Doesn't the Curse of the Black Mage scare you at all?

yes.0: The Arans. Hundreds and hundreds of years ago, five heroes led the people to a distant town in order to flee the Black Mage. Sadly, they failed at defeating the Black Mage and were encased in ice by a curse.
yes.1: Everyone began to forget about the heroes, but there was one girl who never ceased to wait for them. What? You're curious about her? Alright then. Collect #b20#k #b#t04032366##ks that are scattered throughout the town. If you do, you'll find out more about the girl.
